item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E001","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"The Official Gazette record identifies Law No. 91 of 2023 concerning the state general budget for fiscal year 2023/2024, dated 30 June 2023, with the President listed as author.","notes":["The excerpt does not explicitly state that the law was enacted or approved."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"On 30 January 2023, an OHCHR special-procedures communication recorded information alleging the mass arrest of 28 men suspected of homosexuality and the subsequent alleged denial of human rights including freedom from torture and other ill-treatment, privacy, liberty and security, and freedom from discrimination including on the basis of sexual orientation and gender identity or expression.","notes":["The excerpt describes alleged denial of human rights, not specifically denial of protection against torture."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0013-E007","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
